canonicalMutationContractGap.closestCandidate: CAND-02 (findTreatmentCaseInClinic) — but per correctionR1 it is a relation/ownership guard, not a mutation boundary; none of the other six candidates performs or owns a mutation either.
missingProperties: owner_domain_mutation_service — a write-performing function owned by the domain that owns the model, not a lookup preceding a caller's own inline write
full_mutation_predicate — the write's own where/updateMany clause repeats the tenant scope, rather than trusting a prior read
transaction_ownership — explicit statement (and, where needed, an actual $transaction) of what is atomic with what
audit_ownership — explicit statement of whether the mutation function or its caller writes the audit entry
rollback_behavior — explicit statement of how effects are reversed on a caller-side error afterward
